Immigration wait times · October 2026 · updated 5 October 2026

How Long Is the Immigration Queue at Noi Bai Airport in October 2026?

In October 2026, the last passengers off a busy-hour flight at Noi Bai International Airport (HAN) can expect 69–91 minutes from touchdown to clearing immigration — estimated from the month’s flight schedule and the airport’s own 2025–2026 figures. With Fast Track it is under 15 minutes at any hour.

When Fast Track matters most

Flights landing 13:00–24:00, when arrivals from Bangkok, Tokyo, Seoul and Shenzhen land minutes apart. Land 00:00–10:00 — the line is shorter, though rarely short.

October 2026 notes

Hanoi’s best weather month, and the airport feels it. China’s National Day week fills the first seven days from Shanghai, Guangzhou and Shenzhen, Europe and North America are in full autumn season, and from the 25th the winter schedule takes over — so the second half of the month is a different timetable from the first.

How we estimate: a minute-by-minute queue model over the 120 international arrivals on a representative October day, counting deplaning and the walk to the hall. Checked three ways: against the daily immigration volume Noi Bai publishes, against the measured time a manual counter takes per passenger, and against the capacity of the arrivals hall itself.

What We Offer

What Is Airport Fast Track?

A personal airport assistance service that helps you skip the long immigration and check-in queues — with a dedicated staff member guiding you through every step, from landing to exit or from check-in to boarding gate.

Peak hours wait

Save Over an Hour

This is the real queue at Noi Bai during peak flights. Our priority lane bypasses every one of these people — you’re through in 10 to 15 minutes.

Your name. Our sign.

Greeted by Name

Step off the plane and our staff is already waiting — holding a sign with your name. No searching, no confusion. Just follow and relax.

Priority Lane — Noi Bai

All Formalities Handled

Visa stamp, immigration counter, customs clearance, check-in, security — we know every step of the process and handle it all so you don't have to.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know before booking. Can't find your answer? Chat with us on WhatsApp.

You must already have a valid entry document — one of the following:

  • Valid Vietnam Visa
  • Visa Exemption certificate
  • Temporary Residence Card
  • Apec Business Travel Card
  • E-visa or Entry Approval Letter (Chinese nationals)

Fast Track Arrival ([haf_price service="fast_track"]) — our staff meets you on landing and guides you through the priority immigration lane with visa stamp assistance, so you clear immigration in minutes. Baggage Assistance (+$15/person) and VIP Lane (+$10/person) are available as optional add-ons.

Fast Track Departure ([haf_price service="vip_departure"]) — we meet you at the departure entrance and guide you through the priority exit immigration lane and priority security screening. Priority Check-in (+$15/person) is available as an optional add-on.

No. Our service fee covers the personal assistance only. Any official government fees (such as visa stamping fees) are paid separately and directly to the authorities on the day of service.

Yes, a $10 surcharge per person applies for flights during night hours — arrivals between 11:00 PM and 5:00 AM, and departures between 12:00 AM and 7:00 AM. Our service is available 24/7 regardless of flight time.

You can book directly through the website checkout, or via WhatsApp or email. Just send your flight number, date, number of passengers and chosen service. We confirm within 10 minutes.

In October 2026, the last passengers off a busy-hour flight at Noi Bai Airport can expect 69–91 minutes from touchdown to clearing immigration, and 35–50 minutes at quieter hours — estimated from the month’s flight schedule and the airport’s own 2025–2026 figures.

With Fast Track it is under 15 minutes at any hour. See the estimate for your landing time (updated 5 October 2026).

For arrivals, our staff will be waiting inside the arrival hall holding a sign with your name — right after you exit the aerobridge.

For departures, we meet you at the departure hall entrance of Noi Bai International Airport.

No problem at all. We monitor your flight in real time and adjust accordingly. Our staff will be there whether your flight lands early, on time, or late — just as one of our guests experienced when their flight arrived 1.5 hours ahead of schedule.

Yes, absolutely. Our service is available for individuals, couples, families and larger groups. Simply let us know the number of passengers when booking and we'll arrange everything accordingly. Infants under 2 travel free of charge.

Payment is made via PayPal or credit card (no PayPal account needed). You can pay directly at checkout, or we send a secure payment link after confirming your booking. Bank transfer is available for group or corporate bookings on request.

Yes! Many guests book both services for complete peace of mind — arrival assistance when landing in Hanoi and departure assistance when flying out. Just let us know both flight details when booking.

Not Fast Track Arrival — you need Fast Track Connection. Fast Track Arrival ends once you are through immigration at Terminal 2; it does not cover the domestic terminal. If your international flight lands at T2 and your domestic flight leaves from Terminal 1, the connection is a separate journey: immigration, a terminal change and a second check-in.

Fast Track Connection ([haf_price service="connection"]) covers all of it — priority immigration at T2, clear directions across to T1, and our Terminal 1 agent waiting there to take you through priority check-in and security to your gate. See the Connection Service →
